changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [SubjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Subject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NULL, [SubjectCardinality] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [ObjectCardinality] [int] NOT NULL, [PredicateUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [IsNew] [bit] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionRelationshipType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
